scope: Two identity indicators only; all other indicators and process rules remain outside this assessment slice. No FedRAMP readiness, certification or authorization claim.

rows.evidence_checks: Reconciled inventories of all scoped accounts, roles and groups; joiner, mover and leaver automation; privilege change records; execution results and exceptions; stale or orphaned identity detection; coverage of non-user identities and external identity providers.
rows.mapping_rationale: A dedicated assessor record examines lifecycle and privilege automation for all three source populations; generic account inventory alone does not demonstrate the indicator.
rows.failure_modes: Unmanaged groups or service identities, incomplete joiner/mover/leaver coverage, failed disablement jobs, unreviewed privilege changes, or missing population reconciliation.

rows.evidence_checks: Scoped user population and authentication methods; passwordless enforcement and validation; documented feasibility exceptions; strong-password and phishing-resistant MFA enforcement for each exception; enrollment, recovery and bypass paths; execution results and exceptions.
rows.mapping_rationale: A dedicated assessor record distinguishes secure passwordless methods from the source fallback requiring both strong passwords and phishing-resistant MFA. A generic MFA-enabled flag is insufficient.
rows.failure_modes: Password-only fallback, phishable MFA, undocumented feasibility exceptions, unenrolled users, bypass or recovery paths, and policy configuration without enforcement evidence.
